title: Steve Jobs on privacy, Steve Jobs at the D8 Conference (Video)
summary: A short clip of Steve Jobs at the 2010 D8 conference, interviewed by Walt Mossberg, defining privacy as people knowing what they are signing up for, in plain English and repeatedly. The discussion centered on location data.
why: HN reaches for it constantly as evidence of Apple's long-standing privacy stance and as a yardstick for judging Apple, Facebook and others.

quote.text: Privacy means people know what they’re signing up for. In plain English, and repeatedly.
